Web Development Projects and Case Studies

Explore React, Tailwind, WordPress, API integration, and UI/UX case studies built by front-end developer Brent Ogden. Each case study outlines the problem, implementation approach, technologies, and outcome.

  • Denver Socials case study

    A modern landing page experience to highlight various Denver Socials events and their impact on the non-profits that they support.

    Impact: Gave the organization a modern hub to promote their events, explain their mission, and drive signups for local networking and nonprofit support.

  • B Squared Solutions case study

    A bold, modern consulting site built from the ground up using React and Tailwind. The site delivers a structured, animated, and visually engaging experience designed to showcase services, projects, and personal brand credibility.

    Impact: Elevated the brand with a fast, professional, highly-visual site built on reusable components—making future additions and pages quick to build while ensuring visual consistency.

  • Mile High Mashup case study

    A Denver sports hub that aggregates scores, news, facts and videos for local pro sports teams.

    Impact: Provides a curated, Colorado-centric experience for fans to see scores, news, and media in one place.

  • FantasyCentral case study

    A dedicated hub for members of our fantasy leagues to view records, league history, and historical stats in one place.

    Impact: Centralized all-time records, standings, and league history so managers can easily explore stats and storylines.

  • PSP Compass Solutions case study

    A full visual refresh for a consulting firm to better match their expertise and message.

    Impact: Repositioned the firm with a cleaner visual language and clearer explanation of services, improving perceived credibility.

  • Sustainable Geospatial case study

    A careful rebuild of an existing site to remove platform limitations without changing the user-facing design.

    Impact: Migrated a fragile, builder-based site into a modern stack while preserving the visual brand users were used to.

  • A-Denver Roofing Landing Page case study

    A visually engaging landing page for a major roofing company, designed to convert visitors into leads.

    Impact: Created a high-impact, campaign-ready page that ties into the broader corporate site while capturing leads effectively.

  • JB Simply Clean case study

    A small business site with just enough application logic to support user accounts and communication.

    Impact: Gave the business a more professional web presence and basic account management flows for customers.

  • Ranger Golden Stud case study

    A calm and friendly brand site for a client offering Golden Retriever breeding services.

    Impact: Shows off the dog's pedigree, health information, and photos in a warm, trustworthy layout that encourages inquiries.
